name: Lucas String and Intrinsic Tau-Cycle Equivalence
statement: The cyclic Fibonacci-string model and the intrinsic peripheral-$\Theta$ cycle-$\tau$ criterion define the same graph $\Lambda_n$.
proof: Peripheral $\Theta$-classes give a simplex graph $G=\kappa(R)$, and $G^\tau\cong\overline R$. Thus a cycle $\tau$-graph forces $R\cong\overline{C_n}$. Cliques of $\overline{C_n}$ are independent sets of $C_n$, exactly the cyclic binary strings with no adjacent ones, so $\kappa(\overline{C_n})\cong\Lambda_n$; reversing the argument proves the converse.
